_comment: Error response bodies as of module 1.1. NOTE the asymmetry pinned in test_known_defects.py: success responses carry a 'status' key, these do not. static/js/main.js only checks `data.status === 'success'`, so an error is detected by absence rather than by a code. Module 5.7 introduces a typed error model with 'status' and 'error_code'.
